name: Happy Path — Opt-In with Valid PRAN, New Regime, Valid Contribution
goal: User successfully enrolls for Employer NPS Contribution by providing valid PRAN details, selects New Regime, and enters a valid contribution percentage.
constraints: All inputs valid; PRAN is 12 digits; PRAN proof is PDF <5MB; tax regime is 'New Regime'; contribution ≤14.

phases.description: User selects 'Proceed' from intro quick replies.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays employee details confirmation card.

phases.description: User confirms employee details as correct.
User enters valid 12-digit PRAN and uploads valid PDF proof (<5MB).

phases.completionCriteria: Bot prompts for tax regime selection.

phases.description: User selects 'New Regime' and enters 12 as contribution.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot submits update and displays completion message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
